read_first.rule: Before any development loop, reopen current main and active PR plan/manifest, read ledger and relevant evidence/checklist; follow linked plans rather than stale summaries. Compare independent site states, select bounded next task, sync plan/manifest/ledger/private checklist with actual evidence. Never mark verified without separate deployment and manual checks.
read_first.owner_only_query: select item_id, purpose, video_url, manifest_revision, github_status, github_stage, github_revision, workspace_status, workspace_stage from atlas_internal.feature_checklist order by item_id;
read_first.release_gate: exact-head CI and actual desktop/mobile visual QA; record live deployment before marking GitHub verified

scope: Source-first research for actionable written ladder, scaffold, bridge and rooftop access directions. No exhaustive physical ascent inventory or new individual access-structure pins. Preserve existing Hotel Z pilot and historical research. Holovator and fixed-pickup coordinate research remains separate.

external_inventory.retrieval: indexed category list; full page exceeded fetch limit
category list retrieved; individual device coordinates not extracted

attempted_pairs: Rouge 1 courtyard and west plaza screenshots
visual_evidence.result: Six linked JPG requests returned cache errors or HTTP failures. Captions/text read; images not visually inspected or aligned. No image reuse or inferred pixel position.

method.survey_order: Review all 48 sectors and 20 Wild Zones for useful destination approaches, then shared boundary routes; research the ladders, scaffolds, obstacles and roof crossings needed for those directions, not every physical structure.
method.source_policy: Use publicly accessible map category entries, gameplay images and independent descriptions as research; record source attribution, ID, date and coordinate space. Do not copy a guide's map artwork/database or bypass access restrictions. Owner photographs only when unresolved evidence warrants them.
method.alignment_gate: Coordinate alignment applies to eligible Holovator and fixed collectible/item markers only. Use independently matched permanent landmark controls, withheld validation and correct marker semantics. Routine written access steps do not need exact entrance or exit XY.
method.dedup_gate: Reconcile overlapping routes, distinguish relevant ascent/descent steps and pickup identities, preserve original collectible IDs; do not calculate or require a citywide physical ladder/scaffold count.
method.release_gate: Publish evidence-backed written access directions with stable landmarks, prerequisites, photographs when useful and explicit uncertainty. No new individual ladder, scaffold, bridge or rooftop-transition map pins. Preserve existing Hotel Z pilot. Holovator/fixed item pins remain subject to independent identity, geometry and floor gates. Runtime changes require branch QA and visual review. No permanent moving Hyperspace pin.
method.progress_policy: Update manifest revision, plan, register, issue #28 and ledger together. Count researched destinations and useful published routes, not all physical structures; never claim full coverage from partial research.

leads.landmark: Small courtyard in northern building complex
leads.notes: Clear the rock obstacle to reach the courtyard ladder and northern roof; a route to Protein and Pearl is described. Gamer Guides separately describes a northern-path building ladder leading over scaffolding; physical identity of the two ladders is not established.

leads.landmark: Centrico Plaza-facing northern edge
leads.notes: A ladder and platform course is reported close to the tower-facing edge. Screw clues in the existing west/north scaffold areas are candidates, not matched identities.

leads.landmark: Alley reached from Saison Canal
leads.notes: Use the right-side ladder and narrow crossings of the tall scaffolding, then descend to a lower platform. Altissimo also reports an alley Screw and items. Do not merge this structure with the plaza course without aligned evidence.

leads.landmark: Eastern building complex
leads.notes: Sources describe dropping into the enclosed courtyard from adjacent rooftop access; Roto-Glide is reported for the eastern courtyard Screw. Retain the original #12 clue, but exact path identity, initial ladder and landing remain unknown.

leads.landmark: Northern part of sector toward Vert Street
leads.notes: Raider King and StrategyWiki describe a ladder followed by crates or raised platform and a rolling crossing to the next roof. Altissimo marks the southern roof Screw as Roto-Glide-required. Record both descriptions; earliest viable no-glide route is not yet confirmed in-game.
leads.gate_dispute: roll-only route reported by two guides; another lists Roto-Glide

leads.landmark: Eastern edge of Vert Sector 1 / western approach to Vert Sector 3
leads.notes: Ramps, several ladders and a glide across a gap connect platforms. Both sources place the climb near the sector boundary; one assigns the pickup to Vert 3 based on the in-game label. Do not duplicate the same structure in both sectors.

leads.landmark: Courtyard near Café Cyclone
leads.notes: Existing owner route through covered arch to courtyard lift remains authoritative for its photographed approach. Raider King describes a northern scaffolding course from the roof; obstacle-removal methods differ across secondary sources. No new mandatory move requirement or exact ladder location is asserted.

leads.landmark: Hotel Z right/behind courtyard
leads.notes: Owner-photographed Hotel Z ladder and Thonky Mission 16 establish courtyard climb, roof descent to Urbain/Taunie, Roto-Glide unlock, then crossing to adjacent roofs and two web bridges. These are written route observations, not measured bridge endpoints. The ladder is not a newly discovered physical device.

leads.landmark: Between the southern buildings / central courtyard
leads.notes: Two pickups are described at different levels: one accessible by a carefully timed roll to a lower platform, another by gliding to a separate platform. Altissimo also records rock-clearing access and a Roto-Glide requirement for one pickup. Preserve original #23/#24 clues but individual mapping and tier correspondence need visual confirmation.

leads.landmark: West of Rouge Plaza
leads.notes: Independent guide describes using the repaired lift after the worker battle, then navigating around the northern rooftop. Related scaffold and onward roof routes exist but have not been visually matched to the owner-photo arrival or individual original Screw markers.

leads.landmark: Café Classe / Vernal Pokémon Center
leads.notes: Independent sources describe ascending from the street-side Holovator in the café neighbourhood then descending to the enclosed grassy courtyard behind the café. Existing south lift ground image shows public street frontage; exact independent source-to-photo identity not certified. Ordinary Ralts and Bunnelby reported in courtyard.

leads.landmark: Southern edge of enclosed courtyard
leads.notes: Reopened owner central-lift ground photograph: gold lift beside large dark scaffold panels, grassy ground, barred lower windows and geometric window frames. Close eastern-lift map image shows central chevrons on south courtyard edge. This establishes adjacency, not the scaffold's exact base or climbing route. Do not treat lift pixel as scaffold pixel.

leads.landmark: Eastern courtyard facade / northwest rooftop
leads.notes: Owner photograph confirms golden lift against long pale stone blue-shuttered wall. Eastern ground-to-roof arrival scene present. Independent sources describe returning from courtyard via east lift then walking to northwestern roof Screw; matches original #8 roof description, but exact source marker pixel unregistered.
leads.identity_status: matching numbered textual clue, not exact pickup geometry

leads.landmark: Near Café Classe / courtyard descent
leads.notes: Siliconera reports a ladder as an alternative way down from the roof into the enclosed area. Independent source map coordinates unavailable. Visible distant ladder-like structure in east arrival photograph is not proven to be that ladder. No new ladder record or pixel assigned.

leads.landmark: Lower and upper courtyard platforms
leads.notes: Two local Screw pickups on different scaffold levels. Original #6 lower and #7 upper tier descriptions match Gamer Guides regional numbering, but individual screenshot-to-tier identity remains unregistered. Roto-Glide recommended; StrategyWiki reports rolling alternatives, Raider King finds one difficult, Altissimo lists glide. Do not assert mandatory Glide for both. Separate optional descents, not certified continuous roof connections.

leads.landmark: Courtyard scaffold course
leads.notes: TM033 Body Slam on a courtyard platform; Psypokes identifies TM/location and Raider King describes a Roto-Glide descent. Distinguish golden TM pickup from purple Screw items; exact platform and entry not verified.

leads.landmark: Park northwest of Hotel Z
leads.notes: Raider King Vert district #12 describes a relatively simple open-park course using platforms and bridges. Altissimo describes a second scaffold Screw specifically in the grassy plaza; Serebii's regional inventory lists two Screws. Likely existing clue #1, not a verified identity. Other items reported on this scaffold include Exp. Candy S, Nest Ball, Calcium and Fire Stone; do not infer an exact pickup tier.
leads.identity_status: probable clue #1 by northwest-Hotel-Z landmark; marker-level match not confirmed

leads.landmark: Larger building complex, recessed platform
leads.notes: Altissimo's courtyard Screw and Raider King's Vert district #13 distinguish this from the grassy plaza. GameSpot describes reaching a recessed scaffold pickup by climbing and gliding down. Bulbapedia's sector photograph visibly shows a paved inner courtyard, multi-level scaffold and fenced area. It does not show a certified pickup, entry or floor. Glide recommended; StrategyWiki reports a roll alternative, but its viability for this exact marker is not independently tested.
leads.identity_status: probable clue #5 by sector scaffold description; individual marker unresolved

leads.landmark: Green roofs between Vert 4 and Vert 5, wall with pipes
leads.notes: StrategyWiki #22 describes crossing green roof sections from the Vert 4 lift used in its #19-21 route, dropping to a scaffold near pipes, ascending a ladder, then making further rolls to the next structures. Single source for this detailed topology. No exact owner-device match, compass orientation, ladder base or exit. Retain as an alternative described route; do not assert it establishes a continuous route across the owner's three lifts.
leads.gate_dispute: StrategyWiki reports roll-only alternative; Raider King labels its courtyard route Glide-only; GameSpot recommends Glide. Identity of these approaches not fully matched.

leads.landmark: Riverside south of Vert Plaza, east side of larger complex
leads.notes: Altissimo, Psypokes, Raider King and Serebii identify TM001 Headbutt behind breakable rocks. Use Rock Smash, obtained via Mable Research rank 2, to clear the path to the golden TM ball. This is independent of scaffold access and is not a new Screw or progress key.
leads.required_access: breakable rock obstacle; Rock Smash documented

leads.landmark: Hotel Z courtyard to Rogue Mega Beedrill arena
leads.notes: Thonky Main Mission 16 and Bulbapedia's sector entry corroborate the story route: existing Hotel Z courtyard ladder, meeting Urbain/Taunie on roof, Roto-Glide unlock, rooftop and web-bridge crossings, Beedrillite as reward. GameSpot reports Water moves on a web route toward nearby Vert 9; specific move requirement is not established for every bridge. No permanent bridge geometry or exact arena point added.

leads.landmark: Small middle building separate from larger courtyard
leads.notes: Altissimo reports a separate small inner courtyard accessible with Roto-Glide containing Hyper Potion, Ultra Ball and Heal Ball, plus Calcium on southeastern roof. Single detailed text source, not individual map coordinates; not counted as another Screw site. Keep distinct from the larger scaffold courtyard.

leads.landmark: Racine Construction lobby, South Boulevard
leads.notes: Original Screw #19 is behind the lobby desk when access permits. Separate story TM066 Volt Switch and Autographed Plush from Canari after Main Mission 15 Reaching Rank E. Do not repeat the conflicting secondary guide's Rank D claim for that battle. Worker outside exchanges Screws; no new collection entry.
leads.identity_status: matching named indoor clue, no floor-level geometry

leads.landmark: Behind Racine Construction, south of the park between Racine and Le Nah
leads.notes: Sources distinguish park scaffold from boulevard course. Climb to roof height and descend onto the pickup platform. Which of the original #20/#21 corresponds to this route remains unresolved: do not swap or duplicate IDs. Text route only.

leads.landmark: South Boulevard north of Racine Construction
leads.notes: Separate taller roadside scaffold; ladder ascent and transfer to the next platform. StrategyWiki reports Roto-Glide; Raider King describes a roll alternative and easier Glide. Do not assert that Glide is mandatory for every version. Original #20/#21 identity unresolved.
leads.gate_dispute: Glide route corroborated; roll-only alternative reported, not independently playtested

leads.landmark: Restaurant Le Nah and building immediately south
leads.notes: Two guides describe ladder ascent beside/behind southern building and a ledge transfer onto restaurant roof. Original #22 roof clue text matches; raw pickup coordinate matched through link identity, not ladder coordinate.
leads.identity_status: named restaurant roof matches regional clue; no aligned native point

leads.landmark: Isolated building northeast of Racine Construction block
leads.notes: Northeastern ladder on the smaller building and Roto-Glide to Racine roof, where TM080 Iron Defense is reported above fast-travel spot. Do not reuse pickup position as ladder base.

leads.landmark: Roof overlooking Coulant Waterway near Wild Zone 17
leads.notes: TM074 Shadow Ball reached by Roto-Glide from a building to the northeast with ladder access. One guide places it in Rank C or higher group. Exact story gate and whether same ladder as Iron Defense not certified.

leads.landmark: Café Cyclone and Coulant Waterway under bridge
leads.notes: StrategyWiki describes steps south of Café Cyclone down to canal, passing beneath bridge, scaffold ascent, transfer, ladder and beam. Original #16 waterway clue is a boundary lead already present in the 100-item inventory, not an additional Screw. GameSpot describes rooftop/scaffold pair in same neighbourhood; exact connection to this course unknown.

leads.landmark: South Boulevard, northeast of Vert Pokémon Center, southwest of Racine Construction
leads.notes: Existing Side Mission 40 route already live. Thonky and Gamer Guides corroborate Élec, Electric attack and Main Mission 14 access; quest source XY (14670,14907) is not the device glyph. Previously documented W04/W05 chevrons project approximately to (1486,1532)/(1486,1515); same neighbourhood but not independently matched to mission device. Retain existing route and keep both candidate positions in the evidence register only.

leads.landmark: Roof east of Wild Zone 17 / roof complex southeast of grassy area
leads.notes: After restoring the mission lift, a published route crosses a leaf bridge and follows the roof. Original clue #17 links to a separately recorded pickup with vine-bridge approach from the southern rooftops, while Altissimo reports a mission-gated rooftop Screw. This is a strong route-type candidate, not a measured identity or guaranteed continuous crossing. Do not confuse Raider King's own local #19 numbering with our #19 Racine interior clue.
leads.identity_status: source pickup link matched to original roof clue; exact connection to mission40 unverified

leads.landmark: Scaffold next to Racine Construction in Vert Sector 7
leads.notes: Raider King describes a simple ascending platform course next to Racine; source regional clue #18 explicitly specifies scaffolding, separate from the roof clue #17. Database destination marker ID 235589 corroborates the scaffold pickup category. Actual ground ascent base, tier and roof exit remain unknown.
leads.identity_status: matching regional text and database marker link; individual physical ascent unverified

leads.landmark: Wild Zone 17, south of Coulant Waterway
leads.notes: Wild Zone 17 opens after Main Mission 24 Reaching Rank C. Preserve its existing approximate centre and separate guide. Published encounter guide identifies day Klefki, night Lampent and flying Skarmory on/around rooftops; ground burrows for Diggersby and Chespin. These are area descriptions, not fixed spawn pins. No assumption that every nearby rooftop pickup requires Wild Zone unlock.

leads.landmark: Alley near Wild Zone 17, Mega Shard Exchange
leads.notes: DLC Mega Shard trader is a fixed-location navigation lead, separate from daily-changing distortions. Bulbapedia and Serebii corroborate merchant and Genesect Drives, 540 Mega Shards each once relevant Side Mission 191 begins. Exact earliest shop availability differs by source revision and is not asserted. No shop pin or dynamic distortion marker added; existing guide data unchanged.

leads.landmark: Waterway behind Hotel Z
leads.notes: Published routes describe climbing a riverside ladder, moving southeast across the roof and descending scaffold tiers. Regional clue #3 northeast of Hotel Z is a candidate; exact ladder identity relative to owner courtyard ladder not established. No Glide requirement stated for this course by cited guides.

leads.landmark: Hotel Z and taller building east of hotel
leads.notes: Published approach uses rear ladder, Glide to adjacent roof, further hotel roof ladders, blue roof transitions and a final ladder on taller building. Roto-Glide required. Candidate original #4; no surveyed intermediate ladder IDs, roof connection or final point.

leads.landmark: Hotel Z to Nouveau Café near Centrico Plaza
leads.notes: Main Mission 5 introduces rooftop shortcut and a ladder blocked by Mega Crystals. Clear crystals with damaging Pokémon move then follow companion. Independent story approach, not proof the same ladder or all later roof crossings are accessible before Glide.

leads.landmark: Vernal Avenue northwest of Wild Zone 1
leads.notes: Three owner photographs reinspected at baseline: ground view golden arrows on plain stone wall, lawn, bin at left, bench at right; close map ring over yellow lift symbol above Wild Zone 1; rooftop arrival. Terra's Side Mission 23, available after rival battle in Main Mission 10, restores lift after Lv.28 Diggersby encounter. Quest marker 238914 XY (10111,16090) is not lift entrance. Existing approximate owner point (964,1666) retained, no new registration.

leads.landmark: View from Vernal Holovator rooftop arrival
leads.notes: Original roof photograph shows a vertical pale ladder on a more distant facade at image right, above the green Wild Zone barrier. This proves a ladder is visible but not its ground level, roof landing, traversability from the photographed arrival or membership of the named Screw course. Treat as visual research lead, not a mapped ladder.

leads.landmark: Northeastern building complex in Vert Sector 9
leads.notes: Raider King describes lift near Wild Zone 1 followed by roof crossings and Glide for final building. Altissimo corroborates northeastern roof and Glide requirement. Regional original #2 link and database item marker link both target markerId 235101, database heading 235102, raw XY (11039,14738). Database describes a roof near Beedrill; do not equate this with a certified story arena or exact ladder. Existing ID #2 preserved.
leads.identity_status: regional roof clue and database marker link match; exact route-to-point geometry unresolved

leads.landmark: Alternative alley access near southern Vert rooftops
leads.notes: StrategyWiki describes crossing a street, clearing purple sludge, continuing in alley, climbing ladder and heading left along roof then Roto-Glide to next building. Serebii corroborates compatible Water or special Psychic obstacle-clearing moves with sufficient power. Distinguish this from visible ladder on owner roof photo and original Hotel Z ladder. No assumed identity between any of these.
leads.identity_status: alternative source-described route, exact individual ladder unknown

leads.landmark: Smaller rooftop west of grassy square north of Hotel Z
leads.notes: TM019 Power Gem. Raider King and PokeJungle describe a westward roof approach after Roto-Glide; Psypokes reports a web-unfurling move requirement. Serebii labels Vert 5; Altissimo lists Vert 9 while explicitly identifying small building in Vert 5. Record boundary conflict and use landmarks, not certified sector. Story walkthrough confirms web bridge activation by attack and Glide unlock during Mission 16. No new TM or Screw collection key.
